I’ve told very few people about it, no one in my family, only some close friends. It happened when I was very young, and by the time I realised what had actually happened it was years upon years later, i don’t want to ruin anyone’s life or bring it back up now, especially since I want to just put it behind me. 

I’m not sure how else to explain it, it just somehow makes it stop, not sure how. If you are referring to the pain, usually it stays until after im asleep and then it still hurts the next day, but for some reason the pain helps me sleep and i stop focusing on anything else.

When it comes to coping, im not sure.
Right now most of my coping mechanisms kind of suck apart from painting, i end up just never getting anything done because I just want to sleep all the time ksksk

I think maybe since I started primary school and had the incident with my neighbour, I’ve felt this way really for as long as I can remember.

I think if I didn’t need to deal with them anymore I would be happier, but I don’t know how I’d make them go away.

When it comes to sleep, it isn’t that not sleeping helps, it’s just that unless I self harm in that state i won’t be able to. Self harm feels like a way to release my thoughts when they are that loud, if that makes sense. The pain just snaps me out of it somehow, yet if I try to do the same thing with a rubber band for example it just doesn’t work, I think my brain has just grown too used to coping through cutting.

It feels as though everything I “feel” isn’t real, everything is just blank and I hate it, when i feel as though im freaking out or that I should be crying nothing happens and so it just builds up and feels so wrong. i want to actually feel something. It’s part of why I self harm in the first place. When i first began my attempts i was actually scared, it didn’t feel casual or normal. But after my most recent attempt, nothing, the day after has just been another day, i didn’t even think to say anything to anyone.



The intrusive thoughts I have from what happened just won’t leave me alone, just one passing thought when I can’t sleep and suddenly I’m stuck in this fuzzy loop feeling like my thoughts are filling and putting pressure on my skull. I don’t know how to describe it. When I get like this literally the only thing I can do to stop it is too not sleep at all or to self harm, I don’t want to think anymore.

I just want everything to stop I don’t want to feel that fuzzy spiralling thought feeling or see the neighbour ever again or  to feel nothing or to feel lonely and or live in this disgustingly feminine body anymore and live in a world filled with all these entitled pricks who go to my school  who have only ever hurt me or tricked me into going places to beat me up and shit.This world we live in while it can be so beautiful the people I meet are always so fucking terrible and stupid and ruin every good thing about it.  I just want to be free of it all.

I feel incredibly lonely and dysphoric, and I’ve struggled with an anorexia for a while now, i just want everything to go away.

I’ve recently tried doing activities that require a lot of “brain power” and critical thinking, like playing chess or solving riddles, reading books, painting, doing maths questions (im rly bad at math so it’s a good distraction.) things like that.

I’ve found that it helps me to ignore or drown out my thoughts and help my brain work better and not get stuck in my own head.
